name: PROJECT X ZONE
description:
The biggest crossover in history between Capcom, Sega, and Bandai Namco Games has been realized!!
A simulation RPG that brings together popular characters from over 25 titles is coming to Nintendo 3DS.
The unique battle system ``Cross Active Battle'' allows for powerful simultaneous attacks by five or more characters.
